content.short: Cwallet is a social crypto wallet and bot toolkit for holding, swapping, tipping, and airdropping assets.
content.description: Cwallet combines a crypto wallet with Telegram, Discord, and social bot tools. Its public docs and listings describe buying, selling, sending, receiving, swapping, tipping, airdropping, and community-management features across many coins and networks. It is useful for users and communities that want wallet actions directly inside social channels. For TON users, Cwallet is about account access and everyday fund management rather than liquidity routing or analytics. Cwallet is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
